dct_title_s: Taylor's Bridge in New Castle County, Delaware 1972
dct_description_sm: Aerial photograph from the NJ Department of Environmental Protection Aerial Photographs Collection showing New Castle County in Delaware with a portion of New Jersey in the upper right corner separated by the Delaware River before it empties into the Atlantic Ocean.
